% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): axis keys and text keys set in the
% axis body after the plots (behaviour AB3/AB5) still hold for the axis.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[domain=0:2, samples=3]
\addplot {x^2};
\addlegendentry{$x^2$}
\pgfplotsset{title={Late title}, xlabel=$x$, grid=major, legend pos=north west}
\addplot {2*x};
\addlegendentry{$2x$}
\pgfplotsset{every axis/.append style={ylabel=$y$}, violet, line width=2pt}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
